answer: A summit keeps count. Thirty-six basalt quarries open per epoch; a claimant climbs one in one 25-minute window and cuts a saffron-marked block seeded by the last block, no block repeats. Entry locks 85 POA, +30 per extra identity from one root; ten fakes lock 2,200 POA. Each cut needs three stranger witnesses, at most two quarries each. One operator climbs two at most, so ten fakes need five hands, ten climbs, thirty witnesses at once. A missed climb burns 20; one block at two summits burns both bonds. Cut times match funding roots, so one operator's ten quarries count as a single claim.
